summary: Retest of the streak math fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/streak.ts. ALL 4 acceptance criteria PASS on a fresh PRO account. (1) streak-current renders '0' and stat subtitle reads 'best 0' (previously 11 / best 12). (2) streak-freezes reads '1 freeze this month'. (3) Exactly 12 punch dots (streak-dot-0..streak-dot-11) rendered, and getComputedStyle(backgroundColor) is identical rgb(39,39,42) for every dot — matches colors.surfaceTertiary (empty state). (4) No regression: paywall flow (quota-badge -> paywall-purchase -> dev-confirm -> RC 'Test valid purchase' in iframe) still promotes the account to PRO and the pro-badge, streak-card and analyze-button all render on home. No red-screen or console errors from our code beyond the previously-known react-native-svg 'transform-origin' web warning (out of scope per handoff note). Backend GET /api/history returns [] on a fresh device — no seeded history needed cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: streak.ts longestStreak loop (lines 127-135) now correctly gates run++ behind status==='clean'||'frozen'; empty weeks hold the run, narc resets it. Matches spec.

streak.ts currentStreak loop (lines 140-153) walks weeks in reverse and only increments currentStreak for clean|frozen. Empty is tolerated only after started=true; on a fresh account started stays false and currentStreak stays 0. Matches spec.
streak.ts return line 161 uses Math.max(longestStreak, currentStreak) — currentStreak is always <= longestStreak given the invariant above, so the max is a defensive no-op. Harmless.
streak.ts useFreeze (line 167) still parses target.weekStart via new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') which is UTC in modern engines — deterministic monthKey. OK, unchanged from iter_6.
